form.title: Social Security and Medicare Tax on Unreported Tip Income

lines.caption: Total cash and charge tips you received (including unreported tips)
Total cash and charge tips you reported to your employer
Total cash and charge tips you received in 2025. Add the amounts from line 1, column (c), only
Total cash and charge tips you reported to your employer(s) in 2025. Add the amounts from line 1, column (d)
Subtract line 3 from line 2. Include as income on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1c. (See Allocated tips in the instructions.)
Cash and charge tips you received but didn't report to your employer because the total was less than $20 in a calendar month (see instructions)
Unreported tips subject to Medicare tax. Subtract line 5 from line 4
Maximum amount of wages (including tips) subject to social security tax
Total social security wages and social security tips (total of your Form(s) W-2, boxes 3 and 7) and railroad retirement (RRTA) compensation (subject to 6.2% rate) (see instructions)
Subtract line 8 from line 7. If line 8 is more than line 7, enter -0-
Unreported tips subject to social security tax. Enter the smaller of line 6 or line 9. If you received tips as a federal, state, or local government employee, see instructions
Multiply line 10 by 0.062 (social security tax rate)
Add lines 11 and 12. Include as tax on Schedule 2 (Form 1040), line 5, or Form 1040-SS, Part I, line 6a. (See instructions there.)

Name of employer to whom you were required to, but didn't, report your tips; (a) name of employer; (b) employer identification number; (c) total cash and charge tips you received; (d) total cash and charge tips you reported to your employer
